title: Diagnostic Rule Declaration
$comment: Repository-authoritative implementation schema (ticket #55, SPEC-307 section 12: '规则声明 JSON schema 随实现落地'). The declarative red line (SPEC-307 section 4) is structural: MatchSpec is a FINITE primitive set (event_type selector; eq/gt/lt/exists field predicates over payload/correlation; count/rate window aggregates; pid/node_id grouping keys) and there is NO user-defined Python or expression string anywhere — additionalProperties:false at every object level plus the pydantic validators in domain/diagnosis/rules/model.py enforce exactly the obligations below (unregistered event types, duplicate rule_id/code and JSON/Python dual-form divergence fail the startup per SPEC-307 section 8 rows 1-2). The shipped builtin declarations (src/domain/diagnosis/rules/builtin/*.json) are the canonical model_dump of their Python dual form (declarations.py). confidence is the diagnosis THREE-tier static declaration (SPEC-307 section 3) — never the observation ConfidenceKind provenance axis.

rule_id.description: Semantic slug, e.g. DIA-PAT-MISSING (SPEC-307 section 3); unique across the ruleset.

rule_version.description: Semver; a rule-set change is a NEW rule_version, never an in-place semantic edit (SPEC-307 section 7). Traceable into the SPEC-502 diagnoses table and the diagnosis.* event payloads.

code.description: Diagnosis code, e.g. DIAG_PAT_MISSING; unique across the ruleset and the MVP suppression-key head (SPEC-307 section 5).

priority.description: Ordering key, smaller first — orthogonal to severity (SPEC-307 section 5).

confidence.description: Static three-tier rule declaration (#13 Q3-ii); the engine computes no score.

summary_template.description: Explanation template; placeholders are PLAIN payload keys only — attribute/index access is refused at load (declarative red line).

expected_evidence.description: Observation event codes this rule's evidence must come from — interlocked with FaultDefinition.expected_observations (SPEC-307 section 6, ADR-0007 item 5); every entry must be a SPEC-301 section 4 registered event type.

enabled.description: Runtime disable switch (SPEC-307 section 7); disabled rules are skipped at evaluation — a non-error (section 8 row 3).

event_type.description: Observation-class selector; must be a SPEC-301 section 4 registered type — otherwise the startup fails fast (SPEC-307 section 8 row 2).

group_by.description: Grouping keys (correlation addressing, ADR-0006 decision 3); window aggregates compute per group. Default [node_id].

field.description: One-level dotted path into the payload object or the correlation addressing dual form (node_id/pid).

op.description: The finite SPEC-307 section 4 operator set; no user-defined code or expression strings.

value.description: Comparison value for eq (JSON scalar) / gt / lt (number); exists carries no value (null).

scope.description: MVP window scope fixed to per-run (the evaluation batch); virtual-time intervals are a future additive extension.

min_count.description: count aggregation: minimum qualifying records per group.

min_rate.description: rate aggregation: minimum qualifying share among the group's records of the rule's event type.

window.description: MVP-fixed suppression window: one raised per (code, node_id) per run; further hits accumulate as updated.
